about: 2026-10-29 (operator: "what about per song/scripted run over rides? like a song may tell the global runner, nods & arm lifts are these speeds & times to do"; "global knobs > [zKnobs > knobs]"): the global knobs every song starts from. A song's own knobs.json overrides any of them (its "moves", or a step's own value), the way zKnobs.json feeds knobs.json. moves: each move note's values when neither the step nor the song names them. runner: the song runner's shared waits, in seconds.
